title: 30 DAYS OF
CONTENT IN
*ONE* PROMPT
subtitle: Fill in three blanks and get a month of posts, each day with a pillar, a hook and a format.
tagline: From the reel: two weeks without posting

blocks.heading: How to use *it*
blocks.intro: One prompt plans the month. One afternoon films the week. That's the whole system.
steps: Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. The next page has it, ready to copy.
Your niche, who it's for and your goal. [Home workouts, busy moms, more clients.]
Every day comes with a pillar, a hook and a format, laid out as a table.
Film a whole week in one afternoon. A plan you don't batch is just a wish list.
blocks.note: Busy for one afternoon. Posting all week.

items.line: You are my content strategist. I make [niche] content for [who it's for]. My goal is [goal]. Build a 30-day content calendar with three pillars: teach (how-to tips), story (my journey and lessons) and proof (results, wins, behind the scenes). For each day give the pillar, a scroll-stopping hook under 12 words, the format (talking head, tutorial, carousel, trend or story) and one line on what to show. Never use the same pillar more than twice in a row. Show it as a table.
items.example: I make home workout content for busy moms. My goal is more clients.
items.why: Three blanks give the AI who you are, who it's for and what it's for, and the pillars stop the month from repeating itself.

items.line: Quick how-to posts that solve one small problem for [who it's for].
items.example: The 4-minute workout you can do while the kettle boils.
items.why: Useful posts get saved and shared, which tells Instagram to show them to more people.

items.line: Your journey: what you tried, what failed, what you learned about [niche].
items.example: I skipped 3 months of workouts after my son was born. Here's what got me back.
items.why: Stories make people follow you, not just your tips.

items.line: Results and behind the scenes: client wins, before and after, how you work.
items.example: My client trained 15 minutes a day for 8 weeks. Here's what changed.
items.why: Proof turns viewers into clients, which is the goal you gave the AI.

items.line: Turn day [number] into a 30-second script: the hook, 3 short points and a call to action.
items.why: From plan to filming in one message.

items.line: Give me 5 different hooks for day [number]: a mistake, a number, a bold opinion, a question and a story.
items.example: Give me 5 different hooks for day 9...
items.why: Pick the strongest opener instead of settling for the first.

items.line: Group the 30 days into 4 filming sessions by location and outfit, with a shot list for each.
items.example: Kitchen day, living room day, gym day, outdoor day.
items.why: Four afternoons film the whole month.

items.line: Rewrite week [number] for [platform]: same ideas, that platform's length and style.
items.why: One plan feeds every account you run.

blocks.heading: Batch day *checklist*
items: Pick the 7 days you are filming and print their hooks
Group them by location and outfit
Charge your phone and clear 10 GB of space
Film the hook three ways for every post
Film all the B-roll for the week in one go
Write all 7 captions before you edit
Schedule the week and stop thinking about it
blocks.closing: One prompt plans the month. One afternoon films the week.
